text: Introduction

text: 1.1 Purpose
annotated_text: 1.1 Purpose

text: In third quarter 2004, ABC Paint will migrate to a new paint numbering scheme.
annotated_text: In third quarter 2004, ABC Paint will migrate to a new paint numbering scheme.

text: This migration comes at a time that ABC Paint will be adding and discontinuing a number of paints and collections.
annotated_text: This migration comes at a time that ABC Paint will be adding and discontinuing a number of paints and collections.

text: Although the remaining customers who utilize these soon-to-be-discontinued products are encouraged to begin using other paints in our product line, the initial transition is not occurring as rapidly or as easily as ABC Paint would like.
annotated_text: Although the remaining customers who utilize these soon-to-be-discontinued products are encouraged to begin using other paints in our product line, the initial transition is not occurring as rapidly or as easily as ABC Paint would like.

text: For ABC Paint customers to remain loyal and happy, we will create an easy to use system, allowing conversion to the new paints and collections.
annotated_text: For ABC Paint customers to remain loyal and happy, we will create an easy to use system, allowing conversion to the new paints and collections.

text: The new system must be in place by the second quarter of 2004, allowing customers the time to adjust to the new scheme before they will not be able to order the discontinued products.
annotated_text: The new system must be in place by the second quarter of 2004, allowing customers the time to adjust to the new scheme before they will not be able to order the discontinued products.

text: The use of the application will be long-term, used for the immediate transition and in the future when previous customers may return for more paint with old-scheme numbers.
annotated_text: The use of the application will be long-term, used for the immediate transition and in the future when previous customers may return for more paint with old-scheme numbers.

text: This single application will be a version 1.0 product with no previous revisions in use.
annotated_text: This single application will be a version 1.0 product with no previous revisions in use.

text: This standalone product includes features to enable ABC Paint to easily and seamlessly include the application in their current website.
annotated_text: This standalone product includes features to enable ABC Paint to easily and seamlessly include the application in their current website.

text: 2.1 Product Perspective
annotated_text: 2.1 Product Perspective

text: As defined in sections 1.1 and 1.4, the application for ABC Paint will be a first-of-type solution to ensure that their business and their customer's paint selecting experience maintains continuity and consistency throughout their transition to an entirely new product line.
annotated_text: As defined in sections 1.1 and 1.4, the application for ABC Paint will be a first-of-type solution to ensure that their business and their customer's paint selecting experience maintains continuity and consistency throughout their transition to an entirely new product line.

text: The product is a stand-alone web application with a theme mechanism to allow easy integration of the application into the ABC Paint website.
annotated_text: The product is a stand-alone web application with a theme mechanism to allow easy integration of the application into the ABC Paint website.

text: The ColorKast solution is a server based application with a web-based client for consumer and enterprise access.
annotated_text: The ColorKast solution is a server based application with a web-based client for consumer and enterprise access.

text: In some respects, the application is the next generation of the old mechanical, hand-select, palette board system located in paint stores everywhere.
annotated_text: In some respects, the application is the next generation of the old mechanical, hand-select, palette board system located in paint stores everywhere.

text: Primarily, the application will include a old to new product-line "translator," a graphical color chooser, a color search-engine, a user color palette, possibly, an easy to use color matching system, and an administrative interface.
annotated_text: Primarily, the application will include a old to new product-line "translator," a graphical color chooser, a color search-engine, a user color palette, possibly, an easy to use color matching system, and an administrative interface.

text: All of these will be defined and described later in this same document.
annotated_text: All of these will be defined and described later in this same document.

text: The actual user interface will be described in a separate user interface specification whitepaper.
annotated_text: The actual user interface will be described in a separate user interface specification whitepaper.

text: All references to performance or specification apply to the application client.
annotated_text: All references to performance or specification apply to the application client.

text: Specifications and performance estimates apply to the application server only if explicitly stated.
annotated_text: Specifications and performance estimates apply to the application server only if explicitly stated.

annotated_text: 2.2 Product Functions

text: These functions are modularized sub-components of the client application.
annotated_text: These functions are modularized sub-components of the client application.

text: Each of the functions has a single purpose and can accomplish its mission without the other components.
annotated_text: Each of the functions has a single purpose and can accomplish its mission without the other components.

annotated_text: Together, the components function as a stand-alone application.

annotated_text: The first user class is default for all users and allows no administrative functionality whatsoever.
